name: SkyHop (fictional)
summary: Texas roof and construction-site drone photos, captured to order by licensed pilots.
short: Drone photos of Texas roofs and sites, to order.

delivery.basis: Provider pricing page: 'photos within 2 business days'.

human.method: Pilots hold an FAA Part 107 licence.
human.unknown: Licence is checked at hiring, not per flight; an account could be shared.

camera.unknown: Images are not signed; the camera model is stated only in EXIF.

time.method: Server timestamp when the pilot uploads.
time.unknown: Shows when the file arrived, not when it was captured.

location.method: Drone GPS fix written to EXIF.
location.unknown: Consumer GPS can be spoofed; the position is reported, not authenticated.

content.unknown: No signing or integrity check after upload.
